name: Retro Vault Elite YouTube Demo
voiceoverScript: Retro Vault Elite is built for retro game collectors who want something cleaner than a spreadsheet and more collector-first than a generic checklist.
You can browse full retro libraries, search fast, open detailed game views, and keep track of what you own and what you still want.
The vault is built around the way collectors actually think, including condition, editions, values, and the oddball titles that get missed elsewhere.
Missing something obscure? Add your own private entry and keep moving instead of waiting around for someone else to approve it.
Barcode and ID tools are built in, and the next step is making the beta trade system feel naturally connected to the vault.
It is still early, but it keeps getting better from collector feedback, which is exactly how it should grow.
